priority_legend.P0: blocks or invalidates any total algorithmic polynomial-time claim
priority_legend.P1: threatens theorem transfer, asymptotic accounting, or validation coverage
priority_legend.P2: authority, provenance, lifecycle, or status-surface drift

gaps.title: Complete deterministic Policy-0B machine is not frozen
gaps.why_it_matters: Scheduler, reason language, cache query and proof-complexity layers exist, but there is not yet one complete deterministic transition system to which a total-runtime theorem can refer.
missing: deterministic new-reason generation rule and tie breaking
gaps.exit_condition: Freeze POLICY0B.1_COMPLETE_TRANSITION_SYSTEM with all transitions, tie rules and charged data structures.

gaps.title: Universal active representation bound in original input length is missing
gaps.why_it_matters: Polynomial work per current state is useless for a P-time bridge if clauses, reasons, indexes, extension definitions or proof DAGs can be superpolynomial in N.
gaps.exit_condition: Prove one universal polynomial byte bound in original encoded input length N for every retained structure, or refute the frozen retention architecture by an explicit infinite family.

gaps.title: F3-D semantic restriction survival
gaps.why_it_matters: F3 lower-bounds original polarity width/depth, but the heavy-width argument applies after structured NW self-reductions. Syntactic support survival does not imply semantic macro survival.
gaps.exit_condition: Prove a quantitative survival theorem for semantic residual functions under the exact Sokolov NW self-reduction, or exhibit a polynomial-size escape whose large original polarity structure collapses under those restrictions.

gaps.title: Deterministic extension/reason/proof discovery cost
gaps.why_it_matters: Short proofs or polynomially verifiable reasons do not imply that Policy-0B can find them in polynomial time.
gaps.exit_condition: Freeze a deterministic generation/search algorithm and prove total work poly(N), including failed proposals and explored states, or refute it by an infinite family.

gaps.title: Universal ER3 extension-count bound / ER p-boundedness
gaps.why_it_matters: Restricted lower bounds do not settle unrestricted ER3. The global question is polynomially equivalent to the Extended Resolution / Extended Frege p-boundedness frontier.
gaps.exit_condition: Resolve Fundamentum#217 positively or negatively with a valid universal theorem/counterfamily.

gaps.title: NW hard family is existential/high-probability rather than deterministically explicit
gaps.why_it_matters: Current restricted asymptotic lower bounds use suitable random NW graphs. An executable adversarial suite would be stronger with explicit verified instances.
gaps.exit_condition: Provide a deterministic explicit graph family satisfying the required expansion properties, or produce independently checkable expansion certificates for generated hard instances.

gaps.title: C025-F adversarial family regression suite is incomplete or not fully wired
gaps.why_it_matters: Umbrella Issue #213 requires GT, padded GT, masked/lifted Tseitin, PHP, near-threshold random 3-SAT, and synthetic padding attacks. Current audit verified many structural probes but did not verify a dedicated Policy-0B replay for every required family.
gaps.exit_condition: Add one explicit Policy-0B adversarial-family workflow with frozen expected outcomes and claim ceilings for every required family.

verified_sources: Dmitry Sokolov, Pseudorandom Generators, Resolution and Heavy Width, CCC 2022, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.CCC.2022.15
Nicolas Prcovic, Narrowing Extended Resolution, ICTAI 2012, DOI 10.1109/ICTAI.2012.81
gaps.exit_condition: Freeze exact theorem numbers/pages/hypotheses/parameter names and the exact internal lemma consuming each external theorem.

gaps.title: B2-to-ER and ER-to-ER3 translations lack an executable finite translator
gaps.why_it_matters: The mathematical p-simulation claims can be further protected against object-identity drift by executable finite certificate translation.
gaps.exit_condition: Implement finite proof translators/verifiers for B2<->ER normal forms and the relevant ER3 transformation interface, while preserving that finite replay is not an asymptotic proof.

gaps.title: F2/F3 asymptotic proofs are prose mathematics plus finite replay, not machine checked
gaps.exit_condition: Add an independent derivation and, if practical, formalize core combinatorial lemmas in a proof assistant or a small proof-checking DSL.

gaps.title: NW semantic axiom inclusion should have exact source-line binding
gaps.why_it_matters: L1E depends on direct root clauses and same-neighborhood extension clauses being semantic axioms of the source functional encoding.
gaps.exit_condition: Freeze exact source definitions/line ranges and an independent object-level derivation of root-axiom and extension-axiom inclusion.

gaps.title: L1E and L1F parameter regimes can be conflated
gaps.why_it_matters: L1E uses Delta approximately log^(2-delta)n; L1F/F2/F3 use a polynomial-input regime with Delta=C log n. Mixing them can invalidate input-relative exponents.
gaps.exit_condition: Create C025_E2R_PARAMETER_LEDGER.md mapping n,m,Delta,r,epsilon,N,K,S,L,eta,alpha for every theorem.

gaps.title: Explicit eta derivation is not frozen
gaps.why_it_matters: F2/F3 use L(N)>=exp(N^eta) after absorbing source losses. The exact eta dependence should be auditable rather than prose shorthand.
gaps.exit_condition: Freeze an explicit inequality deriving one valid fixed eta>0 from the selected source regime and input encoding.

gaps.title: F3 width-depth recurrence needs an independent overlap/DAG-sharing audit
gaps.why_it_matters: Finite fixtures passed, but overlapping dependency cones, semantic aliases and shared DAG nodes are exactly where loose multiplicative accounting can overclaim.
gaps.exit_condition: Produce a second derivation explicitly covering overlap, aliasing and DAG sharing for S_local <= S^(7*(b+2)^(d+1)).
